Thank you for your interest in the ALTE Common Corpus SIG pilot. You do not need to know GitHub or write anything technical.

Please replace the guidance below with a few short notes. It is fine to leave any section blank.

## About you

Your name, role or organisation, if you are happy to share them:


## Languages or areas of expertise

For example: English, French, Spanish, German, Czech, another language, CEFR, assessment, corpus linguistics, vocabulary, teaching, materials, NLP, validation or research methods.


## How you might like to contribute

For example: review a small set of examples, comment on the methodology, help with a language, test the taxonomy, advise on validation, suggest a use case or contribute technically.


## Any questions

Please add anything you would like to know before deciding whether to take part.
